features: Strict YouTube Music Search Parity: Full unrestricted access to official songs, video songs, albums, verified artists, and playlists
16:9 Landscape Video Previews: Landscape thumbnail rendering in search history and queue panels for video songs
Instant Search History Playback: 1-tap playback from search history without re-search delays
Ultra-Fast Parallel Lyrics Resolver: Sub-300ms parallel lyrics fetching with LRCLIB, lrc.red, and instant video song bypass
fixes: Restored pure YouTube Music search results across songs, videos, albums, and playlists
Bypassed lyrical retrieval for video songs to eliminate unnecessary network latency
Fixed search history item tapping to directly play media or navigate to the target artist/album page
improvements: Landscape 16:9 aspect ratio previews for video songs in queue and search history
LRCLIB ultra-fast lyrics integration with cache version 12 and auto-cleanup
Optimized package footprint and memory efficiency
